summary: Both halves inspected. The proposed q.c.h. equivalences are defined through linearization and strengthened by twisted quasicoherent coefficients with isomorphisms under every structural pullback. The raised homological, (quasi-coherent), F_*, very mild, and only are all typewritten in pen brackets. Both Pi symbols and the phi/arrow symbols are hand-filled. The circled q.c.h. margin note is present. The ra overprint in operates remains doubtful, while the small upper impression in But cannot be securely identified. The final aspiration to localize general semisimplicial schemes to the same category is explicitly withdrawn from further pursuit as possible daydreaming.
